description: Source code for WebTransportFingerprintProofVerifier class, handling fingerprint verification and certificate chain validation in QUIC/WebTransport context.

classes.name: WebTransportHash
classes.description: Represents a hash used for fingerprint verification, including algorithm and value.

classes.name: CertificateFingerprint
classes.description: Represents a certificate fingerprint with algorithm and fingerprint string.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetails
classes.description: Holds details about proof verification status.

classes.name: WebTransportFingerprintProofVerifier
classes.description: Handles verification of certificate fingerprints for WebTransport over QUIC.

methods.name: AddFingerprint
methods.description: Adds a fingerprint or hash to the verifier's list after validation.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies proof, but in this implementation, it always fails as crypto verification is not supported.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Verifies the certificate chain against known fingerprints and checks validity periods and key types.

methods.name: CreateDefaultContext
methods.description: Creates a default proof verification context, returns nullptr.

methods.name: HasKnownFingerprint
methods.description: Checks if a given DER-encoded certificate matches any known fingerprint.

methods.name: HasValidExpiry
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's expiry is within the allowed validity period.

methods.name: IsWithinValidityPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the current time is within the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: IsKeyTypeAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's public key type is permitted by policy.
